name: H'nemthe
description: H'nemthe were bipedal reptilian humanoids with four horns and ridges of bone and skin on their faces. They had long, gently curving noses, three-fingered hands, and pink to blue-gray skin. Their homeworld and native language were also named H'nemthe. The H'nemthe loved the arts, particularly music. They were rarely found off H'nemthe.

data.name: H'nemthe
data.distinctions: Long curved noses, four horns, deadly mating rituals
